title: Terrarian Spears
description: This texture pack replaces Minecraft spears with Terraria spears.
body:
# ABOUT


This texture pack replaces Minecraft spears with Terraria spears!
The list of changes will be below


<details>
<summary>Item List</summary>

1. Wooden spear - Spear
2. Stone spear - Storm Spear
3. Copper spear - The Rotted Fork
4. Iron spear - Dark Lance
5. Golden spear - Gungnir
6. Diamond spear - Mythril Halberd
7. Netherite spear - Chlorophyte Partisan
   


</details>

With these spears all enemies will be pierced!
